research_question: Does a causal M1 swing-failure state transition—known prior swing, wick sweep beyond it, completed close back inside, then a one-bar retest that again closes on the reclaimed side—produce enough 30-second post-confirmation asymmetry to survive frozen P75 execution?
source_basis: Open-source TradingView Swing Failure Pattern implementations define the core event as a wick beyond a prior swing followed by a completed close back inside the prior range.
Open-source SFP/CISD implementations emphasize confirmation after the liquidity sweep rather than entering on the wick itself.
XAUUSD community material explicitly describes sweep -> reclaim -> retest/hold as stronger confirmation than a wick-only reversal attempt.

Federal Reserve Bank of New York research on clustered stop-loss/take-profit orders provides a market-microstructure mechanism for unusual price behavior around widely observed support/resistance and stop clusters.

frozen_signal.price: completed native Dukascopy midquote M1 OHLC
frozen_signal.swing: symmetric 2-left/2-right completed M1 pivot; pivot must be fully confirmed before sweep bar begins
frozen_signal.sweep_reclaim_bullish: bar low < known pivot low AND bar close > pivot low
frozen_signal.sweep_reclaim_bearish: bar high > known pivot high AND bar close < pivot high
frozen_signal.pivot_consumption: consume pivot after first causal sweep-reclaim event
frozen_signal.confirmation: next completed M1 bar must retest the swept level and close again on reclaimed side
frozen_signal.bullish_retest_hold: next bar low <= swept low level AND close > level
frozen_signal.bearish_retest_hold: next bar high >= swept high level AND close < level
frozen_signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after retest-hold bar right edge

failure_rule: If the single preregistered causal sweep-reclaim-retest profile fails supply/day or direct-net gate, retire SRHT rather than rescue it on Stage-A.
advance_rule: If it passes the preregistered gates, freeze unchanged for independent later-January validation.
